definitions.explanation: The condition of carrying a developing embryo or fetus in the body. Also used as a suru verb meaning to become pregnant.

examples.japanese: {妊娠|にんしん}おめでとうございます。
{妊娠|にんしん}{中|ちゅう}はアルコールを{控|ひか}えた{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: It's better to refrain from alcohol during pregnancy.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}が{妊娠|にんしん}したと{聞|き}いて、みんな{喜|よろこ}んだ。
examples.english: Everyone was happy to hear that our friend had become pregnant.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {妊娠|にんしん}する: to become pregnant
- {妊娠|にんしん}{中|ちゅう}: during pregnancy
- {妊娠|にんしん}{検査|けんさ}: pregnancy test
- {妊娠|にんしん}〜{週|しゅう}: (number) weeks pregnant
- {妊娠|にんしん}{初期|しょき}: early pregnancy

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {妊婦|にんぷ}: pregnant woman
- {出産|しゅっさん}: childbirth
- {産婦人科|さんふじんか}: obstetrics and gynecology
- {安定期|あんていき}: stable period (of pregnancy, usually after week 16)
